svg.title: Deebyanshu Jha as a living digital organism
svg.desc: An animated specimen chart. A nucleus labelled DEEBYANSHU JHA sits at the centre of a membrane. Six neural systems grow outward from it: BUILD, SYSTEMS, PROJECTS, EXPERIMENTS, LEARNING and FUTURE. Organelles along those limbs are real projects including the Lamb interpreter, ChatterNet, a WinSock echo server, xv6 study, a portfolio, Project Camp, HostelFix, Rapid Recall, a placement predictor and 700+ solved problems. Smaller cell forms are the languages and tools behind them. Impulses travel the pathways continuously.

g.text: THIS SPECIMEN RESPONDS TO TOUCH — A LIVE CULTURE IS LINKED BELOW
IF YOU ZOOMED IN THIS FAR, YOU ARE EXACTLY THE KIND OF PERSON I BUILD FOR.
